name: The Kroger Co.
summary:
The Kroger (KR) reported earnings of $1.09 per share on revenue of $34.62 billion for the fiscal second quarter ended July 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.05 per share. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.07 per share. The company beat expectations by 1.87% while revenue grew 2.01% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it continues to expect fiscal year non-GAAP earnings of $5.10 to $5.30 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $5.21 per share for the year ending January 31, 2027.

Kroger Co operates retail food and drug stores, multi-department stores, jewelry stores, and convenience stores throughout the United States. It also manufactures and processes some of the food for sale in its supermarkets.
subject: The Kroger Beat Expectations

name: MoneyHero Limited
summary:
MoneyHero Limited (MNY) reported a loss of $0.03 per share on revenue of $15.75 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.02 per share. The company missed consensus estimates by 50.00%.

MoneyHero Limited is a market leader in the online personal finance and digital insurance aggregation and comparison sector in Greater Southeast Asia.
subject: MoneyHero Limited Missed Consensus Estimates

name: Hooker Furnishings Corporation
summary:
Hooker Furnishings (HOFT) reported earnings of $0.11 per share on revenue of $63.25 million for the fiscal second quarter ended July 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.02 per share. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.01 per share. The company beat expectations by 1,000.00% while revenue fell 23.01% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

Hooker Furniture Corp is a home furnishings marketing, design and logistics company offering residential casegoods and upholstery, as well as domestically-produced custom leather and fabric-upholstered furniture.
